title: Brock Purdy ruled out vs. Seahawks. Can Mac Jones carry 49ers offense?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brock Purdy ruled out vs. Seahawks. Can Mac Jones carry 49ers offense?
sources.description: Brock Purdy did not practice all week with a mid ankle sprain he suffered against the Vikings. Kyle Shanahan is optimistic his QB will be back soon.
